How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Perfect backpack!!
Okay, I have been searching for the right bag for SO long, and I finally found my favorite!! I have been using this bag every single day for months and it is perfect. I carry a LOT of stuff in my bag on a daily basis. Don’t ask me why, for some reason I think I will need everything at all times throughout the day: laptop, notebooks, a Bible, sometimes books, medicine, feminine products, pens/pencils, etc. This is the ONLY bag I have found that carries whatever I want comfortably, has enough pockets, and looks super cute. It has tons of pockets, enough to effectively organize anything you want. If you’re a normal person using it for regular daily use, you may not even use all the pockets. I love the material. It doesn’t look cheap, it’s very cute, and I haven’t washed it yet (clearly, don’t judge how dirty it is I’ve used it every day for months) but it looks like it would be easy to wash. Everything is like a canvas-type material except for the brown, which is like a leather. It has adjustable straps, 2 pockets for water bottles, and it is really comfortable to wear. There are 2 places for my laptop or iPad in the back section, and a strap on the back to put it on a suitcase if traveling. Unless this thing breaks, which it hasn’t after months of daily use and hauling around lots of weight, I don’t ever want another bag!

    This backpack has been a game changer! As a nurse who commutes to work every day, I needed a bag that could keep up with everything I carry, and this one exceeds my expectations.

    It easily fits my meals and snacks, my large handled water bottle (which buckles securely in place so I never have to worry about spills), and still leaves my hands free to carry my coffee. There's plenty of room for my nursing supplies, a jacket, and anything else I need throughout the day.

    I've also used this backpack while traveling with my daughter's sports team, and it was just as useful. The dedicated laptop compartment is a huge plus, and there's still plenty of space for all of my travel essentials, plus snacks and drinks for my daughter.

    I've had this backpack for over a month now, and it's one of the best purchases I've made. It's thoughtfully designed, durable, and incredibly versatile. Whether I'm heading to work or traveling for the weekend, this bag has become my go-to. Highly recommend!

    Okay, I have been searching for the right bag for SO long, and I finally found my favorite!! I have been using this bag every single day for months and it is perfect.

    I carry a LOT of stuff in my bag on a daily basis. Don’t ask me why, for some reason I think I will need everything at all times throughout the day: laptop, notebooks, a Bible, sometimes books, medicine, feminine products, pens/pencils, etc.

    This is the ONLY bag I have found that carries whatever I want comfortably, has enough pockets, and looks super cute.

    It has tons of pockets, enough to effectively organize anything you want. If you’re a normal person using it for regular daily use, you may not even use all the pockets.

    I love the material. It doesn’t look cheap, it’s very cute, and I haven’t washed it yet (clearly, don’t judge how dirty it is I’ve used it every day for months) but it looks like it would be easy to wash. Everything is like a canvas-type material except for the brown, which is like a leather.

    It has adjustable straps, 2 pockets for water bottles, and it is really comfortable to wear. There are 2 places for my laptop or iPad in the back section, and a strap on the back to put it on a suitcase if traveling.

    Unless this thing breaks, which it hasn’t after months of daily use and hauling around lots of weight, I don’t ever want another bag!

    I’ve been teaching for 18 years and I have yet to find THE bag. One that isn’t a tote bag (per my chiropractor) but isn’t just a kids backpack. I wanted it all - ample room for the work I bring home, safe spot for my laptops, and the one bougie request - a slot to fit my 40oz travel mug!! I wanted it to be cute, too. I’ve searched high and low - and guys - I’ve found it all and more in this bag!

    First, the bag is so functional!! I can’t believe the storage it has. It looks pretty, and the straps have cushioning and are very comfortable. There are two side pockets that easily hold a 40oz Stanley or Brumate. It has a special strap that keeps it from tipping over and I absolutely love that! I got tired of shoving cups into my other bags, just to have them spill or have to carry them in my hand. The one zippered bag slot has 2 places for laptops, which is outstanding because I have my personal laptop and my work laptop. I no longer hand to pick and choose which one to bring home with me. That slot also has some room for notebooks and papers. The other zippered opening is very spacious and has room for all the teacher stuff… books, notebooks, papers, etc. the smaller zippered area is perfect for sticky notes, pens, pencils - and it has a clip that I like to use for keeping my work ID clipped to when I’m not working so I don’t misplace it. There are two other zippered compartments for additional storage.

    I’m so excited to use this bag! The material seems really durable and hasn’t gotten dirty yet. Seems like you could easily wipe off any dirt or spills. I think it was a great value for the money! I’ll probably order another one to have as a hockey mom travel bag! It would be a perfect weekend bag. And - it has the awesome pocket on the back of the bag that allows you to slip it on top of the handle of a suitcase! That’s a sweet bonus feature that I have to mention!

    Overall - I adore this bag. It took 18 years, but I finally found THE perfect teacher bag. Click add to cart now. You will not regret it!
